mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_document (knowledge_base_id, user_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_path, raw_content, chunk_count, status, error_msg) VALUES (#{knowledgeBaseId}, #{userId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, #{rawContent}, #{chunkCount}, #{status}, #{errorMsg})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rag_document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_document SET file_name = #{fileName}, raw_content = #{rawContent}, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, status = #{status}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
